title: Quanto sia lieto il giorno (Verdelot)
desc: Philippe Verdelot, Quanto sia lieto il giorno. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
